## Definitions

- [statement] Apollo Server is a Node.js GraphQL implementation suitable for an external replacement API. Apollo’s MERN tutorial defines a GraphQL schema, implements query and mutation resolvers, and exposes a /graphql route through Express. (high confidence) — https://www.apollographql.com/docs/apollo-server · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL) · also: https://www.apollographql.com/docs/deploy-preview/<object-id>/apollo-server/integrations/mern
- [statement] Apollo Server is one implementation route for a replacement API. Render names it as a framework that can be integrated into a backend, while Apollo demonstrates defining a GraphQL schema, implementing resolvers, and exposing a GraphQL route in an Express application. (high confidence) — https://render.com/docs/migrate-mongodb-graphql-to-render · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL) · also: https://www.apollographql.com/blog/modernize-your-mern-stack-with-graphql-and-graphos

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MongoDB's Admin API EOL notice explicitly lists GraphQL as having reached end of life on September 30, 2025. The page retains deprecated GraphQL endpoint documentation, so its presence should not be interpreted as evidence of a supported managed GraphQL service. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-app-services-admin-api-v3 · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL)

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The historical migration deadline was communicated as March 12, 2025: MongoDB's April 9, 2024 forum reply gives that date, and Render's migration guide also repeats it. These sources document the earlier schedule rather than proving the actual shutdown date. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/use-graphql-flutter-with-atlas-graphql/275359 · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL) · also: https://render.com/docs/migrate-mongodb-graphql-to-render

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB Atlas GraphQL API is retired; MongoDB lists it as having reached EOL, and a preserved Stitch/Realm GraphQL tutorial warns that its hosted-service instructions no longer work. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-app-services-admin-api-v3 · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL) · also: https://www.joekarlsson.com/blog/getting-started-with-graphql-and-atlas/
- [statement] MongoDB's April 9, 2024 forum reply states that new users could no longer create apps with GraphQL enabled after deprecation. This is a historical product restriction, not a Flutter client configuration remedy. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/use-graphql-flutter-with-atlas-graphql/275359 · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL)
- [statement] Replacing the hosted API can preserve MongoDB Atlas as the database: Render documents hosting an external GraphQL server connected to Atlas, and Apollo demonstrates GraphQL resolvers executing MongoDB collection operations. (high confidence) — https://render.com/docs/migrate-mongodb-graphql-to-render · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL) · also: https://www.apollographql.com/docs/deploy-preview/<object-id>/apollo-server/integrations/mern, https://www.apollographql.com/blog/modernize-your-mern-stack-with-graphql-and-graphos
- [statement] Render’s cutover procedure deploys a replacement server, configures its database connection, repoints clients, and verifies that the new endpoints work before deleting the old App Services app. The guide does not establish compatibility with every former Atlas GraphQL operation. (low confidence) — https://render.com/docs/migrate-mongodb-graphql-to-render · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL)
- [statement] The March 5, 2025 GraphQL EOL heading in the generated seed reference conflicts with the March 12 date in historical MongoDB and Render material. The seed also separately groups GraphQL under September 30, 2025; it should not supply an independent shutdown-date claim. (high confidence) — https://llmsx.org/tree/mongodb-atlas-app-services/ · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL) · also: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/use-graphql-flutter-with-atlas-graphql/275359, https://render.com/docs/migrate-mongodb-graphql-to-render
- [statement] Migration includes a client cutover to the replacement API URL. Render explicitly directs clients to its service URL, and Apollo's example configures Apollo Client with the new server's GraphQL endpoint. (high confidence) — https://render.com/docs/migrate-mongodb-graphql-to-render · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL) · also: https://www.apollographql.com/blog/modernize-your-mern-stack-with-graphql-and-graphos
- [statement] Render's migration sequence deploys a GraphQL server, connects its data sources, updates clients, and verifies the migrated endpoints before deleting the old App Services application. Its advice to delete the application requires a separate assessment of any remaining application dependencies. (low confidence) — https://render.com/docs/migrate-mongodb-graphql-to-render · keywords: Atlas GraphQL API (EOL)
